paper: SeLeP: Learning Based Semantic Prefetching for Exploratory Database Workloads
dataset: Sloan Digital Sky Survey Data Release 7 (SDSS DR7)
data_kind: Real public astronomy records, bounded ordered subset; not synthetic records
scope: New SQLite workload adapted from official SDSS sample-query patterns; not original SeLeP logs, model, or PostgreSQL benchmark reproduction
selection_bias: First 50000 matched spectroscopic records ordered by specObjID; not a random or representative sample of all DR7
download_sql:
SELECT TOP 50000 p.objID,p.ra,p.dec,p.u,p.g,p.r,p.i,p.z,p.type,p.run,p.rerun,p.camcol,p.field,p.extinction_r,
s.specObjID,s.z AS redshift,s.zErr,s.specClass,s.plate,s.mjd,s.fiberID
FROM SpecObj AS s JOIN PhotoObj AS p ON p.objID=s.bestObjID ORDER BY s.specObjID
split: SHA256 of template_id and complete SQL parameter tuple modulo 10: train 0-6, validation 7, test 8-9; unique combinations across executions; familiar templates, held-out combinations, not disjoint astronomical objects
model: Existing selected hybrid_semantics architecture, newly fitted to SDSS traces; original e-commerce weights are not reused
test_transitions: All eligible transitions, no sampling; process one query at a time to bound RAM
selection: Fixed architecture and candidate settings; validation macro Top-1 selects checkpoint epoch including explicit epoch-zero Markov fallback; no tuning from test scores
cache: SQLite pager 128 KiB, mmap disabled, shrink_memory between queries; OS cache is not reset
runtime_smoke: 20 additional seed-501 queries from training parameter buckets; paired none/Markov-2/new neural checkpoint, no injected delay; correctness and operational check only
test_policy: All results and failures retained; candidate misses counted as errors; no model selection from test outcomes
isolation: Sibling folder outside semantic-page-prefetch, copied predictor source, distinct DB/checkpoints/outputs; existing frontend and research artifacts unchanged
